body:
feed, soap, and a clean jar, paid cash. my note below says emerald flecks came from the orchard treatment; the horse kicked away its feed before the crossing was barricaded.

I set it aside to show the neighbor when she returned. Her porch was empty by the time the light was good enough to read it.

There may be a simple reason for the change. Nobody at the next stop could tell us what to do with the first version.
title: weathered bundle note — during the hot afternoon
gloss: A personal field trace precedes the visible emergency response.
rival_reading: Responders could have collected the emerald flecks while crossing treated land; the note or objects do not prove the program began the emergency.
